name: Construction Copilot Gateway
purpose: Single governed conversational entry point for construction questions and workflows

name: AI Context Builder
purpose: Build tenant/project/user context from authorized systems and current work

name: Tool Registry
purpose: Governed catalog of callable tools, schemas, permissions and risk classes

name: Tool Policy Engine
purpose: Evaluates whether an agent may call a tool and whether approval is required

name: Agent Orchestrator
purpose: Plans/delegates multi-step work across specialized agents and deterministic tools

name: Task State Manager
purpose: Tracks agent task states, retries, approvals, outputs and evidence

name: Construction Retrieval Service
purpose: Permission-aware retrieval across plans/specs/RFIs/submittals/libraries/project records

name: Source Evidence Service
purpose: Normalizes citations/page/sheet/record references and evidence confidence

name: Plan Sheet Agent
purpose: Reads plan sheets, notes, callouts, dimensions and discipline context with evidence

name: Specification Agent
purpose: Reads specification sections, requirements, products and execution clauses

name: Addenda Change Agent
purpose: Detects changed drawings/specs/addenda and impact candidates

name: Scope Extraction Agent
purpose: Extracts scope candidates and missing/ambiguous scope evidence

name: Quantity Evidence Agent
purpose: Produces quantity candidates tied to source evidence and review state

name: Service Mapping Agent
purpose: Maps extracted scope to Phase 25 services and proposes missing-service writeback

name: Assembly Mapping Agent
purpose: Maps scope to governed assemblies and flags invalid/missing dependencies

name: Estimate Input Agent
purpose: Suggests quantities/assumptions/input mappings without authoritatively calculating sell values

name: Production Review Agent
purpose: Reviews Phase 26 production assumptions against evidence and library context

name: Crew Equipment Agent
purpose: Suggests crew/equipment alternatives with rationale and Phase 26 tool calls

name: Truck Haul Agent
purpose: Suggests trucking/haul alternatives and delegates math to Phase 26 deterministic tools

name: Material Disposal Agent
purpose: Reviews materials, waste, disposal and source assumptions

name: Estimate Math Review Agent
purpose: Recomputes/checks estimate outputs only via Phase 26 deterministic calculation interfaces

name: Estimate Completeness Agent
purpose: Flags missing lines, assemblies, quotes, assumptions, exclusions or evidence

name: Pricing Source Agent
purpose: Checks rate/price provenance, age, region and source hierarchy

name: Markup Review Agent
purpose: Checks configured markup sequence/basis against governed profile

name: Risk Agent
purpose: Detects scope, quantity, production, pricing, schedule, constructability and commercial risks

name: Conflict Agent
purpose: Finds plan/spec/addenda/RFI/submittal conflicts without resolving them silently

name: Missing Information Agent
purpose: Identifies unresolved data needed before reliable estimate/operation decisions

name: Constructability Agent
purpose: Surfaces access, sequence, temporary work, equipment, logistics and production concerns

name: Safety Advisory Agent
purpose: Surfaces safety/compliance considerations but cannot replace competent-person/regulated decisions

name: Commercial Advisory Agent
purpose: Surfaces notice/change/contract evidence candidates but cannot make legal conclusions

name: Human Approval Service
purpose: Routes protected agent actions to authorized human review and records decision evidence

name: AI Evaluation Service
purpose: Offline/online evaluations, golden datasets, drift and regression testing

name: Model/Prompt Registry
purpose: Versions providers/models/prompts/tools/policies and approved deployment state

name: Feedback Calibration Service
purpose: Captures accepted/rejected suggestions and controlled calibration signals

name: AI Observability & Incident Service
purpose: Logs latency/cost/errors/safety events and supports rollback/fallback

name: AI Digital Twin Context Service
purpose: Provides governed project/estimate/library/workflow state snapshot to agents
